method: Open (not blind) side-by-side of the original, the verified Local result and both GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst renders from gpt-image-26-wider. Rule: cloud_significant only when both renders clearly beat Local and keep the original's essential content; ambiguous when the renders lead to different assessments. Fixed before any Jev call.
jev_input: the licensed original only (the advisor judges a photo before Cloud), prepared as EXIF upright, <= 1568 px a side, baseline JPEG
limits: One cloud_significant photo in eight: the pilot can show whether Jev wrongly suggests Local for it, but cannot estimate how often that error occurs. Night scenes only.
